isolation_compliance.statement: Review was based only on the four designated final artifacts.

object_reports.concrete_reason: The bed is north-wall aligned, with its accessible west bedside zone clear and the bench placed beyond its foot with a visible circulation gap.
The nightstand sits at the bed's northwest bedside, close enough to function as a bedside surface while remaining outside the marked bed egress zone.
The wardrobe is attached to the east wall with an unobstructed dressing and door-opening zone to its room-facing side; validation marks that access target reachable.
The bench is centered at the bed foot with a distinct front sitting zone and does not obstruct the bed's bedside egress or the south-side storage access.
The cabinet is sensibly south-wall aligned, its drawer and folding clearance is open to the room, and it remains clear of the west-south entry door clearance.
The armchair occupies the open southeast portion of the room near the south window side, has a dedicated approach zone, and does not impede the wardrobe access path.
